ACC 2110.title: Principles of Accounting I
ACC 2110.prereqText: ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 and MAT 1010 or higher recommended

CS 1400.title: Fundamentals of Programming
CS 1400.prereqText: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry. CS 1030 recommended.
prereqWords: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry

CYBR 3350.title: Intellectual Property and Cyber Law
CYBR 3350.prereqText: ENGL 2010 and ( INFO 1120 or CS 1030 or LEGL 3000 ) and University Advanced Standing

CYBR 4150.title: Data Security Analytics
CYBR 4150.prereqText: CYBR 2700 and INFO 2410 and University Advanced Standing; ( INFO 3130 and INFO 3410 recommended)

CYBR 4250.title: Database Security and Auditing
CYBR 4250.prereqText: ( INFO 3410 or CYBR 3700 ) and University Advanced Standing

CYBR 4350.title: Web and Application Security
CYBR 4350.prereqText: ( CYBR 2700 or CS 2550 ) and University Advanced Standing

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.
prereqWords: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H with a grade of C- or higher, or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C or higher.

IM 2600.title: Spreadsheet Applications
IM 2600.prereqText: MAT 0980 or equivalent business math knowledge; basic keyboarding skill

INFO 1200.title: Computer Programming I for IS IT
INFO 1200.prereqText: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 recommended; INFO 1120 recommended

INFO 2200.title: Computer Programming II for IS IT
INFO 2200.prereqText: ( INFO 1200 or CS 1400 with a grade of C- or better within the past seven years) or Departmental Approval

INFO 3130.title: Introduction to Applied Data Analytics
INFO 3130.prereqText: Basic statistics course ( MGMT 2340 or STAT 1040 or STAT 1045 or STAT 2040 or STAT 2050 or PSY 3110 ), and basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, or Departmental Approval and University Advanced Standing

INFO 3300.title: Web Systems Development
INFO 3300.prereqText: [( INFO 1200 or IT 1200 or CS 1400 ) and ( INFO 2410 or CS 3520 ) both with a grade of C- or higher within the past seven years] and University Advanced Standing; INFO 2420 recommended

INFO 3330.title: Client-Side Web Development
INFO 3330.prereqText: [( INFO 1200 or IT 1200 or CS 1400 ) and ( INFO 2410 or CS 3520 ) both with a grade of C- or higher within the past seven years] and University Advanced Standing; INFO 2420 recommended

INFO 3360.title: Server-Side Web Frameworks
INFO 3360.prereqText: [( INFO 1200 or IT 1200 or CS 1400 ) and ( INFO 2410 or CS 3520 ) both with a grade of C- or higher within the past seven years] and University Advanced Standing; INFO 2200 recommended

INFO 3410.title: Database Systems and Warehousing
INFO 3410.prereqText: ( INFO 2410 or CS 3520 with a grade of C- or higher within the past seven years) and University Advanced Standing

INFO 3430.title: Systems Analysis and Design
INFO 3430.prereqText: [ INFO 2410 and ( INFO 2420 or CYBR 2700 )] or [ IM 2600 and IM 2800 ] each with a grade of C- or higher within the past seven years] and ( MKTG 2200G or ENGL 2100 ) and University Advanced Standing

INFO 4050G.title: Global Ethical and Professional Perspectives in IS and IT

INFO 4410.title: Database Administration
INFO 4410.prereqText: ( INFO 2410 or CS 3520 within the past five years) and University Advanced Standing

INFO 4810R.title: Internship
INFO 4810R.prereqText: One 3000 or 4000 level course in INFO, IT, MKTG, or MGMT; Department Approval; and University Advanced Standing
prereqWords: One 3000 or 4000 level course in INFO

IT 2600.title: Data Communication Fundamentals
IT 2600.prereqText: INFO 1120 recommended or IT 1600 recommended or CS 1400 recommended

IT 4750.title: Information Technology Operations Capstone
IT 4750.prereqText: IT 4600 , CYBR 4700 and University Advanced Standing

MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1055.title: College Algebra with Preliminaries
MATH 1055.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MGMT 2340.title: Business Statistics I
MGMT 2340.prereqText: MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 , or MATH 1090 or higher, or appropriate test scores

MGMT 3000.title: Organizational Behavior
MGMT 3000.prereqText: MKTG 2200G or ENGL 2010 and University Advanced Standing
